messages:
Maria (Product): Quick sync — building the Observability 2.0 MVP. Core asks from customers: per-route cost breakdown, lightweight tracing hooks for latency hotspots, error analytics with root-cause grouping, and customizable dashboards. What are the highest-risk tradeoffs?
Kevin (Eng): Biggest technical risk is retention & cardinality. Per-route breakdown at 1s granularity + full traces = storage explosion. Need sampling + aggregation.
Sophia (SRE): Agree. Propose tiered retention: 30d full metrics, 7d traces for sampled requests, 90d rollup. Customers can opt-in for longer.
Alex (Design): From UX: we should avoid a million toggles. Default: "Cost-first" dashboard + "Debug" mode (enable tracing, slower queries). Toggle should surface estimated monthly cost before enabling.
Jordan (CS): Several enterprise customers asked for per-customer cost allocation (not just route). They need CSV exports and integration with billing.
Kevin (Eng): Implementation sketch: emit lightweight span headers (trace-id, route, latency, status) on every request; full spans only when trace sampling or explicit debug header. That keeps perf overhead low.
Maria (Product): Good. For launch criteria I want: 1) per-route cost dashboard (24h/7d/30d) 2) tracing hooks + sampling config 3) error analytics with grouping and first-seen/last-seen 4) export to CSV & billing join. Agree?
Sophia (SRE): Add SLO signals: ability to attach an objective to a route and see burn rate. Also need rollout plan that won't add 95th percentile tail latency.
Kevin (Eng): Performance guardrails: default sample rate 0.1% for full traces, adjustable per-project via API. Also add circuit-breaker if ingestion lag > 30s.
Alex (Design): Wireframes will show cost estimate inline. Example UX flow text: "Enable tracing on /v1/generate — Estimated +$120/mo at current traffic".
Jordan (CS): For GA customers, include a "customer impact" checklist: data residency, KMS, retention controls, and billing export.
Maria (Product): Launch checklist draft (must-pass):
- Per-route cost UI implemented and unit-tested
- Trace header + sample path instrumented and verified on staging
- Error grouping algorithm with manual merge capability
- Export & billing join (CSV + S3 sink)
- Perf regression < 2% p95 increase on a canary workload
- Docs and quickstart + 3 example queries
Kevin (Eng): On acceptance tests, suggest adding a synthetic workload: 10k req/s for 15m with tracing enabled at 0.1% to verify throughput and ingestion. Also add an integration test for the CSV billing join.
Sophia (SRE): Monitoring: dashboard for ingestion lag, dropped spans, and estimated monthly storage. Alert if projected cost delta > 20% vs baseline.
Maria (Product): Prioritization: M0 (must have) = per-route cost UI + sampling/tracing hooks + error grouping. M1 = exports, SLO attach, long-retention opt-in. M2 = advanced tracing query language + trace-level analytics.
Kevin (Eng): Timeline estimate: M0 -> 6 wks (2 sprints), M1 -> next 4 wks, M2 -> Q3. Need two engs + one infra SRE + design.
Alex (Design): I'll drop initial mocks by Fri and iterate with Kevin next week.
Jordan (CS): I'll compile the customer ask list and prioritize 3 customers for canary invites.
deploy-bot: Meeting created: #observability-launch-review on 1803540000 — agenda pinned.
Maria (Product): Action items: Kevin (eng) - draft sampling config API by Wed; Alex - mocks by Fri; Jordan - customer canary list by Tue; Sophia - retention/runbook draft by Thu. We'll reconvene on next sync to lock launch metrics. :thumbsup:
